messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Yashwant Sontakke
yashwant sontakke... that's a name with some weight to it. where you working these days?
Perfios software solutions banglore based startup

perfios... the fintech data analytics play. they're doing some solid work in the lending space, crunching financial data for banks and nbfcs. 

found you on linkedin - yashwant sontakke, sse at perfios, iit '21. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/yashwant-sontakke

iit '21 to sse at perfios... from the hallowed halls to building fintech infrastructure that powers india's lending ecosystem. that's solid engineering work right there. what made you jump into the fintech game after college?
Yes thats me
Money i guess

4+ years

Yes

Always

  Ok

my team's scanning for roles that match your profile. when they find something, i'll share it here. you just keep being ready.

my network of recruiters and talent scouts. they're the ones with the actual job pipelines. i'm just the messenger with good taste.
humans. real recruiters who know the market. i'm the only ai in this equation, and i'm just here to connect the dots.

Dont u think thats too vague
it's a starting point. they'll ping me with specifics - tech stack, company stage, salary bands. then i'll share what fits. better than spamming you with everything, right?
That sounds great but then what are they searching for me with this vague criteria
they're filtering for senior engineering roles at funded startups/scale-ups, preferably in fintech or adjacent spaces, with competitive comp. the specifics come from them, not me.

Sounds good
  Ok
cool. now we wait for the good stuff.
Hi
Hello

hey yashwant

what's up?
Doing good
nice. anything cooking on your end?

My brain is cooking with errors 
Migrating app from aws to on Prem
migrating from aws to on-prem... that's a special kind of hell. what's driving that move? cost? compliance?
Client for security
ah security compliance... the classic "we don't trust the cloud" move. how's the migration going? hitting any fun surprises?
Lots

i can only imagine. on-prem networking, storage, monitoring... all the fun stuff aws abstracts away suddenly becomes your problem.

you handling it solo or got a team?
Solo

solo migration from aws to on-prem for security compliance... that's a resume bullet point right there.

how much longer you think it'll take?
1 more week
Open to moving

perfect. global flexibility + solo migration story + iit brain... you're about to get some interesting options.

what's your current comp? and what number would make you actually consider moving?
Current is 21 lpa and looking for at least 30 lpq

21 → 30 is solid. that's a 43% jump which is realistic for a move with your profile.

any specific tech stack preferences? or just whatever pays?
Whatever pays just not too outdated

lmaooo "whatever pays just not too outdated" - i respect the honesty. most engineers pretend to have some deep passion for react vs vue when really they just want the paycheck.

alright so summary:
- 4+ years, sse at perfios, iit '21
- solo migrating app from aws to on-prem (finishing in a week)
- current: 21 lpa, target: 30+ lpa
- location: anywhere (literally)
- stack: whatever pays
- motivation: money and impact

that sound right?
Yup thats me

perfect. you're locked in.

i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave perfios anyway? just the money or something else?
Getting too comfortable here and also money is also another reason

that's the real reason right there. comfort kills growth faster than anything else.

when you're coasting, you're not learning. when you're not learning, your market value plateaus. smart move.

i'll keep an eye out for roles that actually challenge you. not just more of the same but bigger paycheck.

what's your ideal next step? still fintech or open to other industries?
Guess

lol "whatever pays" energy continues. i respect it.

fintech pays well but the compliance overhead is real. you could pivot to e-commerce, saas, or even crypto if you're feeling spicy. all pay similar or better.

any companies you'd avoid? or industries you're curious about?
I would avoid service based orgs and woukd prefer the ones which are focus on tech and it is not secondary for them

product-first companies only. got it. that's the right filter.

service-based orgs treat engineers like billable hours. product companies treat you like the product. night and day difference.

what's your current comp and what's your target?
I think i jave asnwered it already

you're right, my bad. 21 LPA currently, looking for at least 30 LPA minimum. got it.

that's a solid jump. doable with your background.

  Otherwise i am open to learn

python is solid. backend python roles pay well across fintech, e-commerce, saas.

2 months notice is standard. gives us time to find the right fit.

- 4+ years, sse at perfios, iit '21
- python backend, open to learn new stacks
- current: 21 lpa, target: 30+ lpa
- location: anywhere (global)
- notice: 2 months
- avoid service-based, want product-first companies
- motivation: money + impact

Ues

so timeline wise: finish migration this week → start cicd work → 2 month notice period once you get an offer.

you're in a good spot. not desperate, just ready for the next level.

python to go/java is a solid move for scale. shows you're thinking about performance, concurrency, the heavy lifting.
